# Plan: Fix Accessibility Issues — ARIA Roles and Missing aria-labels

## Bug Description

Three axe violations on `/products/catalog.html`:

1. **aria-required-children** — `<div role="list">` inside `sp-sidenav`'s shadow DOM renders with a named slot (`descendant`) but axe sees no `role="listitem"` children when scanning the shadow tree, because `sp-sidenav-item` sets `role="listitem"` dynamically in `firstUpdated` and its slot assignment happens in `update()`.

2. **aria-required-parent** — `sp-sidenav-item[role="listitem"]` elements are not structurally inside `role="list"` from axe's flat-tree perspective when `merch-sidenav-list` wraps `sp-sidenav` in a `<div aria-label>` without a role, disrupting the landmark/list hierarchy.

3. **Missing aria-label** — The Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` in the Resources section has `href` and `target="_blank"` but no `aria-label`. Screen readers cannot communicate that the link opens in a new tab.

## Root Cause

### Issue 1 & 2 — ARIA role hierarchy

`merch-sidenav-list.js` `render()` wraps all content in a plain `<div aria-label="${this.label}">`. A `<div>` with `aria-label` but no `role` is not a valid ARIA landmark and can confuse axe's flat-tree traversal across shadow boundaries. The `sp-sidenav` inside renders its own `<nav aria-label>` — but the outer `<div aria-label>` on the shadow host creates a redundant, role-less labeled container.

Additionally, `merch-sidenav-checkbox-group.js` `render()` has the same pattern: `<div aria-label="${this.label}">` with no `role`.

### Issue 3 — Missing aria-label on Special Offers link

In both test/demo pages that feed the catalog page template, the `sp-sidenav-item` for Special Offers has no `aria-label`:

- `web-components/test/merch-card-collection.test.html` lines 144–153
- `web-components/test/sidenav/catalog-sidenav.test.html` lines 96–102

`SidenavItem.dev.js` forwards the host's `aria-label` to the inner `<a id="item-link">` anchor via `LikeAnchor` mixin, so setting `aria-label` on `sp-sidenav-item` fixes the link's accessible name.

## Relevant Files

| File | Action |
|---|---|
| `web-components/src/sidenav/merch-sidenav-list.js` | Add `role="group"` to the wrapper `<div aria-label>` |
| `web-components/src/sidenav/merch-sidenav-checkbox-group.js` | Add `role="group"` to the wrapper `<div aria-label>` |
| `web-components/test/merch-card-collection.test.html` | Add `aria-label` to Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` |
| `web-components/test/sidenav/catalog-sidenav.test.html` | Add `aria-label` to Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` |

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Fix `merch-sidenav-list.js` wrapper div ARIA role

In `web-components/src/sidenav/merch-sidenav-list.js`, `render()` at line 227:

**Before:**
```js
return html`<div
    aria-label="${this.label}"
    @change="${(e) => this.selectionChanged(e)}"
>
```

**After:**
```js
return html`<div
    role="group"
    aria-label="${this.label}"
    @change="${(e) => this.selectionChanged(e)}"
>
```

`role="group"` is the correct ARIA role for a generic grouping container that has an accessible label. This fixes `aria-required-parent` by providing a valid labeled container that does not conflict with the `sp-sidenav` nav/list hierarchy inside.

### 2. Fix `merch-sidenav-checkbox-group.js` wrapper div ARIA role

In `web-components/src/sidenav/merch-sidenav-checkbox-group.js`, `render()` at line 99:

**Before:**
```js
return html`<div aria-label="${this.label}">
```

**After:**
```js
return html`<div role="group" aria-label="${this.label}">
```

Same pattern as above — the checkbox group already sets `role="group"` and `aria-labelledby` on the host element in `addGroupTitle()`, but the shadow DOM `<div aria-label>` without role still needs the role added for axe compliance.

### 3. Add `aria-label` to Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` in `merch-card-collection.test.html`

In `web-components/test/merch-card-collection.test.html`, lines 144–153:

**Before:**
```html
<sp-sidenav-item
    href="https://www.adobe.com/products/special-offers.html"
    target="_blank"
>
```

**After:**
```html
<sp-sidenav-item
    href="https://www.adobe.com/products/special-offers.html"
    target="_blank"
    aria-label="Open the Special Offers page in a new tab"
>
```

### 4. Add `aria-label` to Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` in `catalog-sidenav.test.html`

In `web-components/test/sidenav/catalog-sidenav.test.html`, lines 96–102:

**Before:**
```html
<sp-sidenav-item href="/products/special-offers.html">
```

**After:**
```html
<sp-sidenav-item
    href="/products/special-offers.html"
    aria-label="Open the Special Offers page in a new tab"
>
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `merch-sidenav-list` shadow DOM wrapper `<div>` has `role="group"` — axe `aria-required-parent` no longer fires for `sp-sidenav-item[role="listitem"]`
- [ ] `merch-sidenav-checkbox-group` shadow DOM wrapper `<div>` has `role="group"` — consistent with its host-level group semantics
- [ ] Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` in `merch-card-collection.test.html` has `aria-label="Open the Special Offers page in a new tab"`
- [ ] Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` in `catalog-sidenav.test.html` has `aria-label="Open the Special Offers page in a new tab"`
- [ ] No new axe violations introduced on the page

## Validation Commands

```
node --check web-components/src/sidenav/merch-sidenav-list.js
node --check web-components/src/sidenav/merch-sidenav-checkbox-group.js
```
